faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do I need a Mac or Xcode?
faq.a1: No. You do everything in the browser. We build and sign the app on our side.
faq.q2: Do I need an Apple Developer account?
faq.a2: Only to publish on the App Store. The preview and the iPhone test work without one.
faq.q3: What if Apple rejects my app?
faq.a3: We explain the reason in plain words, make the changes with you and submit again.
faq.q4: Will changes on my site show up in the app?
faq.a4: Yes, right away. A new build is only needed when you change the icon, name or tabs.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Will Apple accept an app made from my website?
faq.a1: Apple rejects apps that are only a website in a frame. Mobilio adds native tabs, push notifications, an offline screen and a native launch experience, and checks your app before submission. If Apple asks for changes, we help you fix them and resubmit.
faq.q2: Do I need to update the app when my website changes?
faq.a2: No. Content comes from your website, so new products and prices show up right away. You only rebuild when you change the icon, tabs or app settings.
faq.a3: You do. It's published under your Apple Developer account, with your name as the seller.
faq.a4: Your app stays on the App Store and keeps showing your website. You can't ship new versions or send push notifications until you subscribe again.
